name: Silver
summary: A single-stage correction that removes the swirls and light scratches most cars carry, finished with a ceramic coating.
steps: Paint depth analysis and defect report
Panel cleanse and ceramic coating, twelve hour cure
Wheels and tyres coated, trim protected

name: Gold
summary: A multi-stage correction for deeper scratches, holograms and heavy swirling, with stone chips touched in, finished with a ceramic coating.
steps: Paint depth analysis and defect report
Multi-stage machine polish: cut, refine, finish
Stone chips touched in with paint matched to the VIN
Panel cleanse and ceramic coating, twelve hour cure
Wheels off, deep cleaned, coated and refitted
Arches and calipers cleaned and dressed by hand
Glass polished and coated, trim protected
